The deposit amount parameter is consumed exclusively by the deposit entry point
The reserve parameter is only used to select the reserve inside deposit
The new owner parameter is forwarded into the ownership transfer routine

The fee local is computed and validated only within the flashLoan flow
The payback local is derived from borrow balances and used only inside repay
